ui.subtitle: Giya para kadagiti survivors nga kayatda ti agkonsulta iti law enforcement wenno ag-file ti criminal complaints.
ui.hotline_desc: Mandato ti Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) nga mangted ti immediate technical assistance ken mang-coordinate ti imbestigasyon iti cybercrime.
ui.vawc_desc: No kasapulam dagiti officers nga trained specifically para iti Violence Against Women and Children (VAW-C) cases, please contact the PNP specialized unit.
ui.wcpc_name: PNP Women and Children Protection Center (WCPC)
ui.expect_desc: If you choose to file a complaint, the process may include the following steps:
ui.expect_step_1_desc: An officer or staff member may listen to your situation and ask questions to understand what happened and whether it may involve violations of existing laws or policies related to cybercrimes or online harms.
ui.expect_step_2_desc: You may be asked to share details or materials such as screenshots, links, usernames, or dates that can help review your report.
ui.expect_step_3_desc: The agency will assess the information and may coordinate with relevant online platforms or other government agencies, including law enforcement units, to determine possible next steps.
ui.cyberbullying_title: Dadduma pay a Legal a Rekurso
ui.cyberbullying_desc: Kasano ti ag-file ti complaint iti Pilipinas
ui.footer_desc: Biktima ka kadi ti impersonation wenno data privacy violation?
ui.expect_step_4_desc: You may be contacted if additional information is needed or if your case is referred to another office that can assist.
ui.expect_important_desc: You may share information at your own pace and only what you feel comfortable providing. If the process becomes overwhelming, it is okay to pause and seek support.
